clips.title: Layout debugging
clips.caption: Outlines every element and marks the ones that stick out past the right edge in red, with how far. Applies to every visible screen.

clips.title: Show z-index
clips.caption: Labels positioned elements with their z-index. Applies to every visible screen.

clips.title: Reachability (Right hand)
clips.caption: How easy each part of the screen is to reach with the right thumb: green is easy, red is a stretch. Applies to every visible screen.

clips.title: Reachability (Left hand)
clips.caption: How easy each part of the screen is to reach with the left thumb: green is easy, red is a stretch. Applies to every visible screen.

clips.title: Rulers and guides
clips.caption: Pixel rulers along the top and left. Click a ruler to add a guide there; click the same spot again to remove it. Applies to every visible screen.

clips.title: Column grid
clips.caption: A column grid over the page. Set columns, gutter and width in Grid settings. Applies to every visible screen.

clips.title: Baseline grid
clips.caption: Horizontal lines every few pixels (8 by default, in Grid settings) to check vertical rhythm. Applies to every visible screen.

clips.title: Measure area
clips.caption: Drag to draw boxes that show their size and distance to the edges. The page can't be clicked while this is on. Applies to every visible screen.

clips.title: Peek (hold Alt)
clips.caption: Hold Alt (Option) and hover: size, font, colors, contrast, box model, role and name. The same element lights up on the other screens. Applies to every visible screen.

clips.title: Contrast checker
clips.caption: Marks text below WCAG AA contrast (4.5:1, or 3:1 for large text) with its ratio. Text over images and gradients is skipped. Applies to every visible screen.

clips.title: Track focus
clips.caption: Outlines the focused element as you Tab, with its role and accessible name. Applies to every visible screen.

clips.title: Target size
clips.caption: Marks controls under 24px in red and under 44px in amber. Links inside a sentence are exempt. Applies to every visible screen.

clips.title: Small text
clips.caption: Marks text under 12px, and form fields under 16px (iOS zooms into those). Applies to every visible screen.

clips.title: Text spacing (WCAG 1.4.12)
clips.caption: Line height 1.5, letter spacing 0.12em, word spacing 0.16em and paragraph spacing 2em. Content should not get cut off. Applies to every visible screen.

clips.title: Show roles
clips.caption: Labels elements that have a role attribute. Applies to every visible screen.

clips.title: Show ARIA attributes
clips.caption: Labels elements with their aria- attributes and values. Applies to every visible screen.

clips.title: Apply all hover styles
clips.caption: Shows every :hover style at once. Stylesheets from other sites can't be read, so their hover styles are left out. Applies to every visible screen.

clips.title: Apply all focus-visible styles
clips.caption: Shows every :focus-visible and :focus style at once. Stylesheets from other sites can't be read. Applies to every visible screen.

clips.title: Edit content
clips.caption: Makes the whole page editable so you can try out copy. Changes go away on reload. Applies to every visible screen.

clips.title: Hostile CSS
clips.caption: Gives plain elements ugly default styles. Components that set their own styles stay as they are. Applies to every visible screen.

clips.title: Audible changes
clips.caption: Beeps when the page changes, to hear updates you might not see. Applies to every visible screen.

clips.title: Readability
clips.caption: Grades each paragraph with the Automated Readability Index: green is easy (grade 8 or below), amber is harder, red is hard (above 12). Applies to every visible screen.

clips.title: Measure text
clips.caption: Select text to see its characters, words and sentences. 45–75 characters per line reads best. Applies to every visible screen.

clips.title: Disable CSS
clips.caption: Turns off the page's stylesheets and style attributes. Applies to every visible screen.

clips.title: Disable images
clips.caption: Hides images, video, SVG and background images. Applies to every visible screen.

clips.title: Hide cursor
clips.caption: Hides the mouse cursor in the preview, to test with the keyboard. Applies to every visible screen.

clips.title: Design overlay
clips.caption: Put a design export over this screen to compare: opacity, difference blend, split view and offsets. Uses the reference screen.

clips.title: Fill forms with test data
clips.caption: Fills every visible field with valid values: an email, a phone number, dates, names. Nothing is submitted. Applies to every visible screen.

clips.title: Fill forms with edge cases
clips.caption: Fills fields with values that often break things: an invalid email, accented and non-Latin names, very long text, HTML. Applies to every visible screen.

clips.title: Clear forms
clips.caption: Empties every visible field. Applies to every visible screen.

clips.title: Simulator: None
clips.caption: No simulator. Applies to every visible screen.

clips.title: Simulator: Protanomaly
clips.caption: Weak red sensitivity. About 1% of men. Applies to every visible screen.

clips.title: Simulator: Protanopia
clips.caption: No red cones. About 1% of men. Applies to every visible screen.

clips.title: Simulator: Deuteranomaly
clips.caption: Weak green sensitivity, the most common color vision deficiency. About 5% of men. Applies to every visible screen.

clips.title: Simulator: Deuteranopia
clips.caption: No green cones. About 1% of men. Applies to every visible screen.

clips.title: Simulator: Tritanomaly
clips.caption: Weak blue sensitivity. Rare. Applies to every visible screen.

clips.title: Simulator: Tritanopia
clips.caption: No blue cones. Rare. Applies to every visible screen.

clips.title: Simulator: Achromatomaly
clips.caption: Very little color. Applies to every visible screen.

clips.title: Simulator: Achromatopsia
clips.caption: No color at all. Applies to every visible screen.

clips.title: Simulator: Cataracts
clips.caption: Cloudy, blurred, yellowed and low-contrast vision. Applies to every visible screen.

clips.title: Simulator: Glaucoma
clips.caption: Blurred, dark edges. The clear area follows the mouse. Applies to every visible screen.

clips.title: Simulator: Farsightedness
clips.caption: Close-up details are blurred. Applies to every visible screen.

clips.title: Simulator: Astigmatism (Horizontal)
clips.caption: Blur and a ghost image to the side. Applies to every visible screen.

clips.title: Simulator: Astigmatism (Vertical)
clips.caption: Blur and a ghost image above and below. Applies to every visible screen.

clips.title: Simulator: Tunnel vision
clips.caption: Only the center is visible. It follows the mouse. Applies to every visible screen.

clips.title: Simulator: Macular degeneration
clips.caption: The center is blurred out. The spot follows the mouse. Applies to every visible screen.

clips.title: Simulator: CMV retinitis
clips.caption: Dark specks across the view. Applies to every visible screen.

clips.title: Simulator: Photophobia
clips.caption: Light sensitivity: a bright, glaring screen. Applies to every visible screen.

clips.title: Simulator: Bright sunshine
clips.caption: A phone in direct sunlight: washed-out colors, low contrast is lost. Applies to every visible screen.

clips.title: Simulator: Dimmed screen
clips.caption: Brightness at about 40%, like a laptop on battery or a phone at minimum. Applies to every visible screen.

clips.title: Simulator: Night mode
clips.caption: Less blue and more red, like Night Shift. Applies to every visible screen.

clips.title: Pick a page element
clips.caption: Select an element directly inside the preview to inspect its dimensions, spacing, typography and contrast.

clips.title: Export outline data
clips.caption: Download the current outline and measurements as a JSON file.

clips.title: Heading overlays
clips.caption: Mark heading levels on the inspected preview to make the page’s hierarchy visible.

clips.title: Landmark overlays
clips.caption: Outline page regions such as navigation, main content and footer on the inspected preview.

clips.title: Keyboard focus overlay
clips.caption: Number estimated keyboard focus stops on the preview. Verify the actual sequence with Tab and Shift Tab.

clips.title: Clear inspection overlays
clips.caption: Remove the heading, landmark, focus-order and selected-element highlights.

clips.title: Suggestions only
clips.caption: Limit the outline list to items that have a structural or best-practice suggestion.

clips.title: Console message filter
clips.caption: Show all grouped preview messages, or limit them to errors, warnings, logs and information.

clips.title: Clear console messages
clips.caption: Clear the collected preview messages from the current Console view.

clips.title: Export combined HTML report
clips.caption: Save automated results, human review decisions and notes as a readable HTML report.

clips.title: Export combined JSON report
clips.caption: Save combined check results and review notes as structured JSON data.

clips.title: Grid layout
clips.caption: Arrange previews in a grid.

clips.title: Single-row layout
clips.caption: Arrange previews in one horizontal row.

clips.title: Focus one device
clips.caption: Show one selected preview at a time.

clips.title: Sync Clicks & menus
clips.caption: Mirror clicks & menus between linked previews. Unlinked screens keep their independent state.

clips.title: Sync Links & pages
clips.caption: Mirror links & pages between linked previews. Unlinked screens keep their independent state.

clips.title: Sync Scrolling
clips.caption: Mirror scrolling between linked previews. Unlinked screens keep their independent state.

clips.title: Sync Hover
clips.caption: Mirror hover between linked previews. Unlinked screens keep their independent state.

clips.title: Sync Video playback
clips.caption: Mirror video playback between linked previews. Unlinked screens keep their independent state.

clips.title: Sync Typing & form fields
clips.caption: Mirror typing & form fields between linked previews. Unlinked screens keep their independent state.

clips.title: Preview annotations
clips.caption: Add notes, strokes, lines and arrows to the reference preview.

clips.title: Site address
clips.caption: Enter the website to open on the device wall. The extension can open your own pages; the web demo uses the bundled sample site.

clips.title: Search tools and features
clips.caption: Find any Samestate tool by name or purpose. Filter by category, then choose a result. Press Command K or Control K to open this search.

clips.title: Interface theme
clips.caption: Choose the appearance of Samestate itself. Preview-page palettes are configured separately in the Theme section.

clips.title: Add comparison site
clips.caption: Add another website column to the current side-by-side comparison.

clips.title: Watch the demo
clips.caption: Start the guided walkthrough on the bundled sample website.

clips.title: Use your own site
clips.caption: Open your own website in the installed Chrome extension to inspect it across devices.

clips.title: Screenshot format
clips.caption: Choose PNG, JPEG or PDF for screenshots. PNG preserves crisp interface detail; JPEG is useful for photographs.

clips.title: Workspace name
clips.caption: Name the current device and layout setup before saving it as a reusable workspace.

clips.title: Workspace file
clips.caption: Select an exported Samestate workspace file to import.

clips.title: Search devices
clips.caption: Filter device presets by their name or dimensions. This search does not change the current selection.

clips.title: Screen settings
clips.caption: Give alternating previews different browser preferences or visual conditions to compare how the page responds.

clips.title: Preview theme preset
clips.caption: Choose a bundled or tweakcn colour palette to try on the website previews.

clips.title: Live reload
clips.caption: Reload linked previews on a timer, or watch local sites for changed scripts, stylesheets and page content.

clips.title: Find elements
clips.caption: Enter a CSS selector and highlight matching elements across all connected previews.

clips.title: AI API key
clips.caption: Enter the credential required by your AI provider. Voice help does not read or speak this field’s value.

clips.title: Expected text
clips.caption: Enter text that should appear on every preview, then add it as a test assertion.

clips.title: Saved test file
clips.caption: Select a Samestate test JSON file to load its journey steps.

clips.title: Scroll the preview wall
clips.caption: Move horizontally through the device wall to reach previews outside the visible area.

clips.title: Choose demo step
clips.caption: Jump directly to any of the 46 guided steps. Samestate prepares that feature’s scene and holds it after the explanation.

clips.title: Previous demo step
clips.caption: Return to the previous scene and replace its narration with the matching explanation.

clips.title: Next demo step
clips.caption: Move forward to the next scene and its narration without waiting for the current explanation to finish.

clips.title: Pause or resume the demo
clips.caption: Pause both the guided actions and narration. Resume continues automatic playback.

clips.title: Mute demo narration
clips.caption: Turn demo narration off or on. The choice is saved in this browser.

clips.title: Close the guided demo
clips.caption: Stop the walkthrough and narration, restore temporary demo settings, and keep the sample site available to explore.

clips.title: Close results panel
clips.caption: Hide the right-hand panel to give the preview wall more room.

clips.title: Outline view
clips.caption: Switch between the page’s headings, landmark regions and estimated keyboard focus sequence.

clips.title: Design reference image
clips.caption: Choose a design export to overlay on this preview for visual comparison.

clips.title: Design export scale
clips.caption: Tell Samestate whether the reference image was exported at one, two or three times its design size.

clips.title: Design overlay opacity
clips.caption: Adjust how transparent the reference image is over the live page.

clips.title: Design blend mode
clips.caption: Use normal, difference or inverted blending to make mismatches between the design and page easier to see.

clips.title: Design split view
clips.caption: Reveal part of the reference image beside the live page for a split comparison.

clips.title: Design horizontal offset
clips.caption: Move the reference image left or right to align it with the page.

clips.title: Design vertical offset
clips.caption: Move the reference image up or down to align it with the page.

clips.title: Show design reference
clips.caption: Show or hide the reference image while keeping its alignment and settings.

clips.title: Remove design reference
clips.caption: Remove the reference image from this preview.

clips.title: Grid columns
clips.caption: Set how many columns are drawn by the column-grid overlay.

clips.title: Grid gutter
clips.caption: Set the gap in CSS pixels between adjacent overlay columns.

clips.title: Grid maximum width
clips.caption: Set the maximum content width of the column-grid overlay.

clips.title: Grid side margin
clips.caption: Set the space between the column-grid overlay and the viewport edges.

clips.title: Baseline spacing
clips.caption: Set the CSS-pixel spacing between the horizontal baseline-grid lines.

clips.title: Search tools and features
clips.caption: Search by a tool’s name, a synonym or what you want to do. Field values and preview-page text are not searched.

clips.title: Tool category
clips.caption: Limit the tool search to a category such as Capture, Debug, Reports or Test runs.

clips.title: Close tool search
clips.caption: Close the tool search and return focus to the control that opened it.

clips.title: Preview percentage
clips.caption: Set the scale of this preview as a percentage of its CSS pixel size.

clips.title: Monitor calibration
clips.caption: Measure the displayed calibration line on your monitor and enter its length in millimetres.

clips.title: Physical screen width
clips.caption: Enter the real device’s screen width in millimetres to match its physical size on your monitor.

clips.title: Preview note
clips.caption: Write a note to place on the preview. Notes can be included in captures; voice help does not read their contents.

clips.title: Capture
clips.caption: Save screenshots, full-page images, overview sheets and recordings. Set their format, pace and destination here.

clips.title: Workspaces
clips.caption: Save and reopen device and layout setups, or export and import them for backup and sharing.

clips.title: Devices
clips.caption: Search device presets, select the screens on your wall, and create custom viewport sizes.

clips.title: Views
clips.caption: Choose sizing modes, page-step journeys, browser preferences and responsive breakpoint previews.

clips.title: Theme
clips.caption: Try colour palettes on the website previews and control which screens receive them.

clips.title: Layout
clips.caption: Arrange the device wall, align previews, set orientation and zoom, or lock an arrangement.

clips.title: Sync
clips.caption: Control which actions are mirrored between linked previews, align screens and configure live reload.

clips.title: Compare
clips.caption: Choose a reference screen, detect differences, sweep responsive widths and test longer text or broken links.

clips.title: Find elements
clips.caption: Find elements by CSS selector and inspect matching positions across your previews.

clips.title: Run all checks
clips.caption: Combine selected automated checks with human visual reviews and export one result.

clips.title: Test runs
clips.caption: Write, record, import, replay and save test journeys, with optional AI assistance.

clips.title: AI connection
clips.caption: Configure the provider, address, model and credential used for AI test writing.

clips.title: Physical size
clips.caption: Calibrate your monitor and enter a real device width to show a physically sized preview.

clips.title: Device preset
clips.caption: Select or remove this device size from the preview wall.

clips.title: Device group
clips.caption: Expand or collapse this group of device presets.

clips.title: Remove custom device
clips.caption: Delete this custom device preset from the device catalogue.

clips.title: Custom device name
clips.caption: Give your custom viewport a recognisable name.

clips.title: Custom viewport width
clips.caption: Set the custom viewport width in CSS pixels.

clips.title: Custom viewport height
clips.caption: Set the custom viewport height in CSS pixels.

clips.title: Custom device frame
clips.caption: Choose the phone, tablet or desktop frame surrounding the custom viewport.

clips.title: Save custom device
clips.caption: Add this named viewport to your custom device presets.

clips.title: Save workspace
clips.caption: Save the current selected devices and preview layout under the name you entered.

clips.title: Open saved workspace
clips.caption: Restore this saved device and layout setup.

clips.title: Delete saved workspace
clips.caption: Remove this saved setup from your workspace list.

clips.title: Next matching element
clips.caption: Highlight the next match of the current CSS selector across all connected previews.

clips.title: Add text assertion
clips.caption: Add a test step that checks whether your expected text appears on every linked preview.

clips.title: Remove test step
clips.caption: Remove this step from the current saved test journey.

clips.title: Preview scale
clips.caption: Change this preview’s scale or calibrate its physical size on your monitor.

clips.title: Preview debug tools
clips.caption: Choose debug overlays and visual simulators for this preview.

clips.title: Link or unlink preview
clips.caption: Include this screen in synchronized actions, or unlink it to keep an independent page state.

clips.title: Rotate preview
clips.caption: Switch this touch-device preview between portrait and landscape.

clips.title: Reload preview
clips.caption: Reload the page on this preview only.

clips.title: Focus this preview
clips.caption: Show this preview on its own, or return to the current device-wall arrangement.

clips.title: Close preview
clips.caption: Remove this screen from the current wall or journey.

clips.title: Move a preview
clips.caption: Drag this title bar to place the preview on the wall when the layout is unlocked.

clips.title: Viewport dimensions
clips.caption: These are the page viewport dimensions in CSS pixels, before preview scaling.

clips.title: Preview annotations
clips.caption: Open drawing tools for notes, lines, arrows and freehand marks on this preview.

clips.title: Freehand drawing
clips.caption: Drag on the annotation layer to draw a freehand mark.

clips.title: Draw a line
clips.caption: Drag on the annotation layer to place a straight line.

clips.title: Draw an arrow
clips.caption: Drag on the annotation layer to point out an element with an arrow.

clips.title: Place a note
clips.caption: Choose a position on the preview and add a written note.

clips.title: Erase annotation
clips.caption: Select an existing annotation to remove it.

clips.title: Edit preview note
clips.caption: Open this preview note for editing.

clips.title: Save preview note
clips.caption: Place the written note on the selected preview.

clips.title: Cancel note editing
clips.caption: Close the note editor without saving the changes.

clips.title: Comparison site address
clips.caption: Enter the website or page for this comparison column.

clips.title: Open comparison page
clips.caption: Load this column’s entered address in its previews.

clips.title: Close comparison column
clips.caption: Remove this website column from the comparison.

clips.title: Comparison viewport
clips.caption: Choose the viewport or device-wall setup for this comparison column.

clips.title: Open visual review tools
clips.caption: Open the tool associated with this visual review so you can inspect the page before deciding.

clips.title: Pass visual review
clips.caption: Record that you inspected this visual item and it passed.

clips.title: Fail visual review
clips.caption: Record that your inspection found a problem in this visual item.

clips.title: Skip visual review
clips.caption: Record that this visual item was not reviewed in this run.

clips.title: Reset visual review
clips.caption: Return this item to awaiting human review and clear its decision.

clips.title: Visual review notes
clips.caption: Add evidence or comments for this review. The notes are included in exported combined reports.

clips.title: Stop combined checks
clips.caption: Stop the active grouped check run and restore temporary settings.

clips.title: Inspect outline element
clips.caption: Highlight this page element and read its CSS dimensions, spacing, typography and related suggestions.

clips.title: Accessibility guidance
clips.caption: Open the linked W3C guidance for the associated accessibility or best-practice suggestion.

clips.title: Difference finding
clips.caption: Inspect the finding details and highlight the affected element on the relevant previews.

clips.title: Finding screen
clips.caption: Show the details for this affected preview and highlight its corresponding element.

clips.title: Preview a suggested fix
clips.caption: Try or undo a temporary CSS fix in the previews. The source website is not edited.

clips.title: Detect differences again
clips.caption: Run a fresh scan to update the report and retry previews that did not answer.

clips.title: Finding category
clips.caption: Filter the difference report to this category of findings.

clips.title: Findings by issue
clips.caption: Group the same kind of finding together and show the devices it affects.

clips.title: Findings by device
clips.caption: List report findings under the individual previews they affect.

clips.title: Save comparison baseline
clips.caption: Save or replace the current findings as the baseline for later scans of this site.

clips.title: Clear comparison baseline
clips.caption: Remove the saved baseline for this site.

clips.title: New findings only
clips.caption: Show findings that appeared after the saved comparison baseline.

clips.title: Check preview fixes again
clips.caption: Scan the page again after applying or undoing temporary preview fixes.

clips.title: Undo all preview fixes
clips.caption: Remove every temporary CSS fix currently applied to the previews.

clips.title: Read metadata
clips.caption: Read the reference page’s title, description, social cards, canonical URL and other metadata again.

clips.title: Light social card preview
clips.caption: Show social-sharing cards as they would appear on a light background.

clips.title: Dark social card preview
clips.caption: Show social-sharing cards as they would appear on a dark background.

clips.title: Export difference report
clips.caption: Choose a file format and save the current difference findings.

clips.title: Apply preview scale
clips.caption: Apply the entered preview percentage to this screen.

clips.title: Actual CSS pixel scale
clips.caption: Show the preview at one display pixel per CSS pixel before browser-level scaling.

clips.title: Automatic preview scale
clips.caption: Return this preview to the scale calculated for the wall layout.

clips.title: Cancel scale change
clips.caption: Close the scale dialog without applying the entered value.

clips.title: Match physical screen size
clips.caption: Apply monitor calibration and the entered real device width to this preview.

clips.title: Done with settings
clips.caption: Close this settings dialog. Changes already applied to the preview remain in effect.

clips.title: Align previews to top
clips.caption: Align the device previews along their top edges.

clips.title: Align previews to middle
clips.caption: Align the device previews by their vertical centres.

clips.title: Align previews to bottom
clips.caption: Align the device previews along their bottom edges.

clips.title: Samestate
clips.caption: Open the Samestate home view.

clips.title: Request a device preset
clips.caption: Open a GitHub feature request for a missing device preset.

clips.title: Open theme editor
clips.caption: Open tweakcn to create a palette, then copy its exported CSS into the custom-theme field.

clips.title: Metadata preview link
clips.caption: Open the link associated with this metadata or social-sharing preview.

clips.title: Debug tools and simulators
clips.caption: Apply debugging overlays or a visual simulator to the selected preview or the whole wall. Several debug tools can be combined.

clips.title: Measurements and suggestions
clips.caption: Inspect the selected element’s size, box model, typography and practical guidance.

clips.title: Computed styles
clips.caption: Expand the element’s computed styles and its distances from the viewport edges.

clips.title: CSS measurement
clips.caption: Measurements use CSS pixels before preview scaling and visual filters. Check the selected element in the live preview.

clips.title: Combined check result
clips.caption: Review this group’s status, findings and any human review decisions or notes.

clips.title: Expand result details
clips.caption: Expand or collapse the findings or journey details for this result.

clips.title: Search result
clips.caption: Choose this result to open or run the matching Samestate tool.

clips.title: Element size
clips.caption: The selected element’s rendered width and height in CSS pixels, before preview scaling.

clips.title: Page position
clips.caption: The selected element’s horizontal and vertical position relative to the full page.

clips.title: Element margin
clips.caption: The outer spacing around the element, listed as top, right, bottom and left.

clips.title: Element padding
clips.caption: The inner spacing between the element’s content and border, listed as top, right, bottom and left.

clips.title: Element border
clips.caption: The border thickness at the element’s top, right, bottom and left edges.

clips.title: Display and gap
clips.caption: The element’s layout display mode and the gap between its layout items.

clips.title: Text size and line height
clips.caption: The computed font size and line height of the selected element. Normal line height may not resolve to a pixel value.

clips.title: Text weight and spacing
clips.caption: The computed font weight and the additional spacing between characters.

clips.title: Text contrast
clips.caption: The calculated foreground-to-background contrast ratio and its typical target. Verify text over complex backgrounds visually.

clips.title: Estimated line length
clips.caption: An estimate of how many characters fit on a line. Use it to review reading comfort alongside the actual rendered text.

clips.title: Layout debugging
clips.caption: Outlines every element and marks the ones that stick out past the right edge in red, with how far.

clips.title: Show z-index
clips.caption: Labels positioned elements with their z-index.

clips.title: Reachability · Right hand
clips.caption: How easy each part of the screen is to reach with the right thumb: green is easy, red is a stretch.

clips.title: Reachability · Left hand
clips.caption: How easy each part of the screen is to reach with the left thumb: green is easy, red is a stretch.

clips.title: Rulers and guides
clips.caption: Pixel rulers along the top and left. Click a ruler to add a guide there; click the same spot again to remove it.

clips.title: Column grid
clips.caption: A column grid over the page. Set columns, gutter and width in Grid settings.

clips.title: Baseline grid
clips.caption: Horizontal lines every few pixels (8 by default, in Grid settings) to check vertical rhythm.

clips.title: Measure area
clips.caption: Drag to draw boxes that show their size and distance to the edges. The page can't be clicked while this is on.

clips.title: Peek · hold Alt
clips.caption: Hold Alt (Option) and hover: size, font, colors, contrast, box model, role and name. The same element lights up on the other screens.

clips.title: Contrast checker
clips.caption: Marks text below WCAG AA contrast (4.5:1, or 3:1 for large text) with its ratio. Text over images and gradients is skipped.

clips.title: Track focus
clips.caption: Outlines the focused element as you Tab, with its role and accessible name.

clips.title: Target size
clips.caption: Marks controls under 24px in red and under 44px in amber. Links inside a sentence are exempt.

clips.title: Small text
clips.caption: Marks text under 12px, and form fields under 16px (iOS zooms into those).

clips.title: Text spacing · WCAG 1.4.12
clips.caption: Line height 1.5, letter spacing 0.12em, word spacing 0.16em and paragraph spacing 2em. Content should not get cut off.

clips.title: Show roles
clips.caption: Labels elements that have a role attribute.

clips.title: Show ARIA attributes
clips.caption: Labels elements with their aria- attributes and values.

clips.title: Apply all hover styles
clips.caption: Shows every :hover style at once. Stylesheets from other sites can't be read, so their hover styles are left out.

clips.title: Apply all focus-visible styles
clips.caption: Shows every :focus-visible and :focus style at once. Stylesheets from other sites can't be read.

clips.title: Edit content
clips.caption: Makes the whole page editable so you can try out copy. Changes go away on reload.

clips.title: Hostile CSS
clips.caption: Gives plain elements ugly default styles. Components that set their own styles stay as they are.

clips.title: Audible changes
clips.caption: Beeps when the page changes, to hear updates you might not see.

clips.title: Readability
clips.caption: Grades each paragraph with the Automated Readability Index: green is easy (grade 8 or below), amber is harder, red is hard (above 12).

clips.title: Measure text
clips.caption: Select text to see its characters, words and sentences. 45–75 characters per line reads best.

clips.title: Disable CSS
clips.caption: Turns off the page's stylesheets and style attributes.

clips.title: Disable images
clips.caption: Hides images, video, SVG and background images.

clips.title: Hide cursor
clips.caption: Hides the mouse cursor in the preview, to test with the keyboard.

clips.title: Design overlay
clips.caption: Put a design export over this screen to compare: opacity, difference blend, split view and offsets.

clips.title: Grid settings
clips.caption: Columns, gutter, width and baseline for Column grid and Baseline grid.

clips.title: Fill forms with test data
clips.caption: Fills every visible field with valid values: an email, a phone number, dates, names. Nothing is submitted.

clips.title: Fill forms with edge cases
clips.caption: Fills fields with values that often break things: an invalid email, accented and non-Latin names, very long text, HTML.

clips.title: Clear forms
clips.caption: Empties every visible field.

clips.title: None
clips.caption: No simulator.

clips.title: Protanomaly
clips.caption: Weak red sensitivity. About 1% of men.

clips.title: Protanopia
clips.caption: No red cones. About 1% of men.

clips.title: Deuteranomaly
clips.caption: Weak green sensitivity, the most common color vision deficiency. About 5% of men.

clips.title: Deuteranopia
clips.caption: No green cones. About 1% of men.

clips.title: Tritanomaly
clips.caption: Weak blue sensitivity. Rare.

clips.title: Tritanopia
clips.caption: No blue cones. Rare.

clips.title: Achromatomaly
clips.caption: Very little color.

clips.title: Achromatopsia
clips.caption: No color at all.

clips.title: Cataracts
clips.caption: Cloudy, blurred, yellowed and low-contrast vision.

clips.title: Glaucoma
clips.caption: Blurred, dark edges. The clear area follows the mouse.

clips.title: Farsightedness
clips.caption: Close-up details are blurred.

clips.title: Astigmatism · Horizontal
clips.caption: Blur and a ghost image to the side.

clips.title: Astigmatism · Vertical
clips.caption: Blur and a ghost image above and below.

clips.title: Tunnel vision
clips.caption: Only the center is visible. It follows the mouse.

clips.title: Macular degeneration
clips.caption: The center is blurred out. The spot follows the mouse.

clips.title: CMV retinitis
clips.caption: Dark specks across the view.

clips.title: Photophobia
clips.caption: Light sensitivity: a bright, glaring screen.

clips.title: Bright sunshine
clips.caption: A phone in direct sunlight: washed-out colors, low contrast is lost.

clips.title: Dimmed screen
clips.caption: Brightness at about 40%, like a laptop on battery or a phone at minimum.

clips.title: Night mode
clips.caption: Less blue and more red, like Night Shift.

clips.title: Layout & content
clips.caption: Automatic · responsive layout, images, text, navigation and fields. Select this group to include it in a combined check run.

clips.title: Accessibility & usability
clips.caption: Automatic · contrast, names, headings, landmarks and keyboard structure. Select this group to include it in a combined check run.

clips.title: Meta & page errors
clips.caption: Automatic · metadata, social tags, JavaScript and resource errors. Select this group to include it in a combined check run.

clips.title: Performance & page weight
clips.caption: Automatic · Web Vitals and network findings; measurement gaps stay visible. Select this group to include it in a combined check run.

clips.title: Broken links
clips.caption: Automatic · same-origin HEAD requests without cookies; action links skipped. Select this group to include it in a combined check run.

clips.title: Test journey
clips.caption: Automatic · a saved test, or a plan followed with your AI connection. Select this group to include it in a combined check run.

clips.title: Screen settings & long text
clips.caption: Automatic + review · scan each non-vision setting and longer text. Select this group to include it in a combined check run.

clips.title: Responsive width sweep
clips.caption: Automatic · sample 320–1920px; can take a few minutes. Select this group to include it in a combined check run.

clips.title: Visual tools & interactions
clips.caption: Human review · debug tools, simulators, panels, forms and sync. Select this group to include it in a combined check run.

clips.title: Capture & file output
clips.caption: Human review · screenshots, recordings and exported reports. Select this group to include it in a combined check run.

clips.title: Workspace portability
clips.caption: Human review · save, reopen, export and import. Select this group to include it in a combined check run.
